# Forgkit quarantine record

No source is vendored here. As of 2026-08-10, searches of GitHub's public
repository and user APIs, npm, and PyPI found no project or package named
`Forgkit`. An authoritative owner, upstream URL, immutable revision, license,
and plugin API therefore cannot be established. Similar names (including
ForgeKit) are not treated as the requested dependency.

Forgkit is denied by default and must not be registered or executed. Adding it
requires a new ADR with an owner-confirmed URL, commit SHA, license text, API
contract, source audit, and reviewed policy capabilities.
